Read the data

Read the data and metadata.

outDir <- "~/Projects/AML/out/Proteomics"
dir.create(outDir, recursive = T)
## Warning in dir.create(outDir, recursive = T): '/home/francesco.marabita/
## Projects/AML/out/Proteomics' already exists
# assayData
read.table("~/Projects/AML/data/Proteomics/proteins_no_dups.txt",
           header = T, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F, row.names = 1)  %>% 
  type_convert()  -> assayData
## Parsed with column specification:
## cols()
# pData
batch.info <- read.xlsx("~/Projects/AML/data/Proteomics/labelling-scheme-bytmtchannel.xlsx",
                   sheet =1, colNames =T, rowNames = F, skipEmptyRows=T)

batch.info %>% 
  group_by(Patient.ID) %>% 
  summarise(Set=paste(unique(Set),collapse = ","),
            Channel=paste(unique(Channel),collapse = ","),
            Proteomics.Label=paste(unique(Proteomics.Label),collapse = ","),
            is.a.replicate=paste(unique(is.a.replicate),collapse = ",")) %>% 
  filter(Patient.ID %in% colnames(assayData)) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("Patient.ID") -> pData

pData <- pData[colnames(assayData),]

Annotate the features with Ensembl 92

ensembl92 <- useMart(host="apr2018.archive.ensembl.org", biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
fields <- c("ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name", "start_position", "end_position",
            "strand","description", "hgnc_symbol", "entrezgene", "gene_biotype")

fData <- data.frame("hgnc_symbol"=rownames(assayData), stringsAsFactors = F)

annot <- getBM(fields, mart=ensembl92, filters="hgnc_symbol", values=fData$hgnc_symbol, useCache = F)

# remove alternative assembly
annot <- annot[annot$chromosome_name %in% c(1:22, "X", "Y", "MT"),]

# remove duplicated 
annot <- annot[!duplicated(annot$hgnc_symbol, fromLast=T),]

# create annotation table
fData <- merge(fData, annot, sort=F, all.x=T)

rownames(fData) <- fData$hgnc_symbol
fData <- fData[match(rownames(assayData), fData$hgnc_symbol),]

Create SummarizedExperiment

# create SummarizedExperiment

prot.se <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = list(logRC=as.matrix(assayData)))

if(all(rownames(prot.se)==rownames(fData))) {
  rowData(prot.se) <- DataFrame(fData)
} else { stop("Order is different") }

if(all(colnames(prot.se)==rownames(pData))) {
  colData(prot.se) <- DataFrame(pData)
} else { stop("Order is different") }
plot_frequency(prot.se)

plot_missval(prot.se)

plot_detect(prot.se)
## Warning: Removed 99 row(s) containing missing values (geom_path).

plot_coverage(prot.se)

QC plots

boxplot(assays(prot.se)$logRC, las=2, ylab=expression(log[2](RQ)))

geneplotter::multiecdf(assays(prot.se)$logRC, subsample=F, legend=F, xlim=c(-3,3))

pheatmap(as.matrix(dist(t(assays(prot.se)$logRC))),
         clustering_distance_rows=dist(t(assays(prot.se)$logRC)),
         clustering_distance_cols=dist(t(assays(prot.se)$logRC)),
         annotation_col = as.data.frame(colData(prot.se)[,c("Set","Channel","is.a.replicate")]),
         col=rev(colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(255)),
         main="Sample distance", border_color = NA)

breaksList <- seq(-1,1, by=0.1)
pheatmap(as.matrix(cor(assays(prot.se)$logRC, use = "complete")),
         clustering_distance_rows=as.dist(1-cor(assays(prot.se)$logRC,use = "complete")),
         clustering_distance_cols=as.dist(1-cor(assays(prot.se)$logRC, use = "complete")),
         annotation_col = as.data.frame(colData(prot.se)[,c("Set","Channel","is.a.replicate")]),
         color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdBu")))(length(breaksList)),
         breaks = breaksList, main="Sample correlation", border_color = NA)

Save data

save(prot.se, file = "~/Projects/AML/data/Proteomics/AML_proteomics_se.RData")
